$comment: The only hand-written part of the token catalog. One entry per token whose role the source comment cannot state on its own: either it has no comment, or the comment above it describes a neighbour. `purpose` is the role sentence shown in the catalog; `stability` is alpha unless a token has been deliberately settled.

--ds-components-general-background-defau.purpose: The page behind everything. Nothing is painted under it.

--ds-components-general-border-default.purpose: The line that separates one area from another: dividers, table rules, the edge of a panel. The edge that identifies a control is --ds-components-general-border-control.

--ds-components-general-foreground-defau.purpose: Ordinary reading text on background or surface.

--ds-components-general-foreground-secon.purpose: Text that supports the main text: hints, captions, units. Still has to reach 4.5:1.

--ds-components-general-background-disab.purpose: The fill of a control that cannot be used right now.

--ds-components-general-foreground-disab.purpose: The text of a control that cannot be used right now. It is exempt from the contrast minimum, so never carry meaning by this colour alone.

--ds-components-general-focus-ring-color.purpose: The colour of the ring that shows where the keyboard is. It needs 3:1 against whatever it is drawn on.

--ds-components-general-background-hover.purpose: The translucent state layer laid over a control, action, option or row while the pointer is on it. It preserves the role of the fill underneath.

--ds-components-general-background-press.purpose: The overlay laid over a control while it is being pressed.

--ds-components-general-action-primary-b.purpose: The fill of the one action a screen is asking for: the primary button, and the selected state that follows from it.
The same fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

--ds-components-general-action-primary-f.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the primary fill.

--ds-components-general-action-secondary.purpose: The fill of an action that is present but not the one being asked for. Same hue as the primary: secondary is a job, not a second colour.
The secondary fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.
Text and icons drawn on the secondary fill.

--ds-components-general-feedback-info-so.purpose: The colour of a message that tells you something, without anything being wrong.

--ds-components-general-feedback-success.purpose: The colour of a message that says something worked.

--ds-components-general-feedback-warning.purpose: The colour of a message that says to be careful.

--ds-components-general-feedback-danger-.purpose: The colour of a message that says something failed, and the fill of an action that destroys something.
The danger fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

--ds-components-general-feedback-solid-f.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a solid status fill: information, success, danger.

--ds-components-general-feedback-warning.purpose: Text drawn on the warning label fill (solid Tag, Count). It is dark, because the light warning colour cannot carry white text.

The fill behind a text label with the warning status: the solid Tag and the Count. The warning colour gives dark text 3.8:1 only; this fill gives it 4.5:1 or more. Glyphs, dots and meter fills keep the warning colour.

--ds-components-general-emphasis-backgro.purpose: An area that should stand out from the page around it, such as a tooltip or an inverted panel.

--ds-components-general-emphasis-foregro.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the emphasis area.

--ds-components-general-feedback-info-bo.purpose: The edge of the tinted information surface.

--ds-components-general-feedback-success.purpose: The edge of the tinted success surface.

--ds-components-general-feedback-warning.purpose: The edge of the tinted warning surface.

--ds-components-general-feedback-danger-.purpose: The edge of the tinted danger surface.

--ds-components-general-selection-foregr.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a selected item.

--ds-components-general-emphasis-border-.purpose: The edge of the emphasis area.

--ds-components-general-feedback-neutral.purpose: The colour of a message that carries no status at all.
The quiet fill of a control or chip that carries no status: a plain tag, a default button.
The edge that goes with the quiet neutral fill.

--ds-components-page-background-default.purpose: The page behind everything, per theme (component.light.page-background and component.dark.page-background in the design source): the background role in the light theme, Black in the dark one. The application paints it; the components do not.

--ds-components-card-background-default.purpose: The background of a card, per theme: the background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--ds-components-card-secondary-backgroun.purpose: The background of a card with the secondary surface, per theme: the neutral surface role in the light theme, Grey 900 in the dark one.

--ds-components-dialog-background-defaul.purpose: The background of a dialog panel, per theme: dialog, sheet, alert, confirm, prompt and search dialogs. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--ds-components-popover-background-defau.purpose: The background of a popover, per theme: popover, hover card, date picker popups and the navigation menu panel. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--ds-components-menu-background-default.purpose: The background of a menu or a listbox, per theme: dropdown menu, context menu, menubar menus, combobox and multi-select listboxes. The background role in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one.

--ds-components-sidebar-background-defau.purpose: The background of a sidebar, per theme: the background role in the light theme, Black in the dark one.

--ds-components-code-block-background-de.purpose: The background of a code block, per theme: Grey 50 in the light theme, Grey 950 in the dark one. The text keeps 4.5:1 on it; the border draws its edge against the page.

--ds-components-dialog-overlay-default.purpose: The scrim behind a modal dialog, per theme (role.light.dialog-overlay and role.dark.dialog-overlay in the design source). How far it sets the dialog apart from the page is a theme choice, not an accessibility requirement.

--ds-metrics-density-touch-min-target-si.purpose: The side of the smallest square hit area a control keeps under a coarse pointer: 44 by 44 (density.touch.min-target-size). Visual density never reduces it.

--ds-elevation-overlay.purpose: The shadow under something floating over the page: a menu, a popover, a dialog. It changes between themes, because a shadow reads differently on a dark page.

--ds-components-general-border-control.purpose: The boundary that identifies an interactive control: fields, outlined buttons, check controls, the switch track. It reaches 3:1 on the page and on a surface; the generic border stays the quieter line between areas.

--ds-components-general-action-secondary.purpose: The secondary action's fill: the quiet tint the secondary button paints.
Text and icons drawn on the secondary action's fill.

--ds-components-general-action-danger-ba.purpose: The destructive action's fill: the danger button. Distinct from the danger status tint, which sits under a message rather than an action.

--ds-components-general-action-danger-fo.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the destructive action's fill.
